project.description: CellCraft E2E Test - ScatterPlot Node Test (03-scatter-plot.spec.js)

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: UPTIME_KUMA_PUSH_URL
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Uptime Kuma Push Monitor URL for ScatterPlot Node Test

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash
echo "=========================================" echo "Starting E2E Test - ScatterPlot Node..." echo "Base URL: $PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL" echo "========================================="
# Jenkins 컨테이너 내부에서 작업 디렉토리 생성 E2E_WORK_DIR="/tmp/e2e-03-$$" E2E_AUTH_DIR="/jenkins-home/e2e-auth"
mkdir -p "$E2E_WORK_DIR" mkdir -p "$E2E_AUTH_DIR"
# 필요한 파일들 복사 cp -r /workspace/frontend/tests "$E2E_WORK_DIR/tests" cp /workspace/frontend/playwright.config.js "$E2E_WORK_DIR/" cp /workspace/frontend/package.json "$E2E_WORK_DIR/"
# 복사된 .auth 디렉토리 삭제하고 영구 디렉토리로 심볼릭 링크 생성 rm -rf "$E2E_WORK_DIR/tests/e2e/.auth" ln -s "$E2E_AUTH_DIR" "$E2E_WORK_DIR/tests/e2e/.auth"
cd "$E2E_WORK_DIR"
# Playwright 설치 (첫 실행 시만 필요, 이후에는 캐시됨) if [ ! -d "node_modules/@playwright" ]; then npm install @playwright/test fi
# E2E 테스트 실행 - ScatterPlot Node Test export PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL="${PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL:-http://cellcraft-frontend-1:8080}" export PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_WEBSERVER='true' export PLAYWRIGHT_HEADLESS='true'
npx playwright test \ tests/e2e/workflows/03-scatter-plot.spec.js \ --reporter=junit \ --reporter=html \ --project=chromium
TEST_EXIT_CODE=$?
# 테스트 결과를 Jenkins workspace로 복사 mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE/test-results" cp -r test-results/* "$WORKSPACE/test-results/" 2>/dev/null || true cp -r playwright-report "$WORKSPACE/" 2>/dev/null || true
# 임시 디렉토리 정리 cd / rm -rf "$E2E_WORK_DIR"
# Uptime Kuma 알림 if [ -n "$UPTIME_KUMA_PUSH_URL" ] && [ "$UPTIME_KUMA_PUSH_URL" != "http://uptime-kuma:3001/api/push/YOUR_KEY_03" ]; then if [ $TEST_EXIT_CODE -eq 0 ]; then echo "=========================================" echo "ScatterPlot Node Test Passed!" echo "=========================================" curl -s "${UPTIME_KUMA_PUSH_URL}?status=up&msg=ScatterPlot%20Node%20Test%20Passed" || true else echo "=========================================" echo "ScatterPlot Node Test Failed!" echo "=========================================" curl -s "${UPTIME_KUMA_PUSH_URL}?status=down&msg=ScatterPlot%20Node%20Test%20Failed" || true fi fi
exit $TEST_EXIT_CODE
